checks.claim: both outputs are LF-only UTF-8 with a final newline
every feed row has exactly the shared-feed fields, in order
feed rows are exactly the final rows graded in the selected set, once each
each feed row mirrors its corpus row: span, confidence, review state, the row's own hold, non-authorizing, no promotion authority
no witness bytes, quotation mark or internal code in any feed prose field
every why_low_confidence is non-empty and unique
every sentence of why_low_confidence is found verbatim in that row's own prose
no judged rating travels in the feed
review_packet_final_state equals a re-derivation from the row's status, its hold and the last audit verdict, on every feed row and every unit
one unit record per final row
measured, dependency and judged are separate blocks; the judged block is labelled a rule, and the risk rating is left out and said to be left out
every span exists on both witnesses, the spans tile the book, and each unit's primary span and size match an independent positional alignment of the two numberings
contested-between-blind-lanes equals an independent re-read of the lanes' verdicts
answerable-from-the-witnesses is one of three stated values, and left_out says what it means
writer ids and decision ids are the same ids in two spellings (the sidecar keys on the former)
severities landed equal an independent recount from the packets
onset seam evidence on both faces equals a re-derivation from the marks file and the inventory
every routed end-review item is an open-question record, once
every unresolved entry, escalation, inventory end-review item, strategy line and end-review finding without a routed id is an open-question record
every open question carries one of the four blast-radius classes, labelled as assigned by rule
no convention question is filed as one unit (the record's own convention words, and this checker's own words over the routed items' text)
a question that names no unit is never filed as one unit or several units
a routed item whose id names no unit is filed one_book or wider
every linkage is harvested from a named source: each source, re-opened at its locator, names both units (a cross-reference names one and cites a verse inside the other)
treated-differently equals a re-comparison of the two final rows
every linked pair treated differently carries a statement (real distinction or possible inconsistency) with its basis; none is unremarked
the sidecar has exactly the selected rows, once each, and every required field is non-empty
every sidecar why_low_confidence is unique and equals the atlas row's

selftest.what: each tamper is applied in memory to a copy of the outputs; a tamper that no check catches fails the run

tier: MEASURED by this checker; it shares no code with the generator, but it was written by the same builder on the same model family, so it is not independent review
limit: The checker proves form, mirroring, tracing and harvest. It cannot prove that a rule-assigned class or statement is the right reading; those are labelled JUDGED_BY_RULE.
